delta.content: {"objective": "Configure the BMI088 gyroscope at its widest usable full-scale range and confirm the setting in the register map.", "prerequisites": ["The BMI088 datasheet, the revision that carries table 3 and section 5.3", "SPI or I2C access to the sensor from a host that can read and write registers"], "steps": [{"number": 1, "title": "Read the range register", "action": "Read register GYRO_RANGE and note its current value.", "why": "The selectable range is written there; the reset value is the widest setting.", "inputs": ["the register address of GYRO_RANGE"], "outputs": ["the current GYRO_RANGE value"], "verify": "The read returns a value in 0x00..0x04."}, {"number": 2, "title": "Select 2000 deg/s", "action": "Write 0x00 to GYRO_RANGE to select the 2000 deg/s full-scale range.", "why": "0x00 is the code for 2000 deg/s in the register map.", "inputs": ["the current GYRO_RANGE value"], "outputs": ["GYRO_RANGE = 0x00"], "verify": "Reading the register back returns 0x00."}, {"number": 3, "title": "Confirm the scale", "action": "Rotate the board at a known rate and compare the reported rate against it.", "why": "A register read confirms the setting; a measurement confirms the scale.", "inputs": ["a known rotation rate"], "outputs": ["the measured rate"], "verify": "The reported rate matches the known rate within the datasheet tolerance."}], "decisions": [{"divergence_id": "d1", "topic": "gyroscope full-scale range", "options": ["Treat 2000 deg/s as the maximum, selectable in steps down to 125 deg/s", "Treat 1000 deg/s as the maximum"], "recommendation": "Use 2000 deg/s.", "rationale": "Two of the three positions and the cited datasheet table agree on 2000 deg/s; the 1000 deg/s figure was withdrawn without a reason."}], "risks": [{"risk": "The datasheet revision in hand may number the tables differently.", "mitigation": "Locate the range table by its register name, not its number."}], "done_when": ["GYRO_RANGE reads back 0x00", "A known rotation is reported within tolerance at the 2000 deg/s scale"]}
